name: pencil-check
description: A compact pencil with a separate completion check.
useCase: Finish editing with an explicit action label.
misuse: Do not assume a pencil-check universally means Save.

16.reason: The shared shortened pencil stays intact; the separate lower-right check balances its upper-right cap without an overlap knot. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.
